name: Coffee Pub Artificer
tagline: A crafting, recipe and blueprint system.
description: Crafting for Foundry with recipes, blueprints, gathering and skills, plus a recipe journal cover and authoring tools.
pitch: Forage herbs, ores and parts from your scenes, then craft potions, poisons, food and gear at a crafting station. GMs set what each scene yields.

features.title: Foraging and gathering
features.text: Players forage a scene; successful rolls place gathering spots as map pins to harvest components.

features.title: Crafting Station
features.text: Load a recipe, drag ingredients onto the bench, set process and intensity, then craft.

features.title: Scene habitats
features.text: GM ticks habitats in a scene's Geography tab to set which components it yields.

features.title: No-code authoring
features.text: GMs create new components, recipes and crafting processes without writing code.

features.title: Recipes and blueprints
features.text: Recipes can be read, written and imported; compendiums of components, creations, tools and recipes ship with the module.

features.title: Skill mapping
features.text: Character skills map onto crafting and gathering (docs note some skills and perks are not built yet).

steps: Give a scene a habitat in Scene Configuration, Blacksmith Geography tab.
Forage and Scavenge with a token, then Gather and Harvest at the spots to collect components.
Open the Crafting Station from the hammer icon in the Blacksmith menubar, load a recipe, drag in ingredients, and craft.
